title: 第07章 浑不吝
slug: 夜天子全本免费-夜天子最新章节列表
content_zh:
这女子白皙光洁的额头下，一双远山似的黛眉轻轻地颦着，似乎锁着一缕看不见的轻愁。细细一管小腰儿使一根细细的带子系了，便有一种婉约从骨子里透出来。
她娉娉婷婷扶门而立，那油漆斑驳、裂缝处处的房门竟也因之透出一种雅致来，虽是布衣荆裙，体态削瘦，竟是清丽无双。
这女孩儿生就一股柔美，叫人见而生怜。所谓祸水，不一定要美到颠倒众生，而是那种姿容气质能直接掳获你的心，让傻老爷们为了她拼尽一腔热血也心甘情愿，眼前这女子明显具备这样的条件。
叶小天看到这样一个妙人儿，虽然出身天子脚下，见过许多丽人，却也不免一呆，心中暗道：“歹竹出好笋呀，杨霖螇蟀成精一般的德性，不想竟生出一个狐狸相貌的女儿。”
那少女独居陋处，从不与人往来，每个月也只有杨府家丁来送一次糙米，这居处又是死胡同里，连门前都无人经过，如今陡然看见一个陌生男子，还是冲着她来的，惊讶之余不免生出几分戒意，轻声问道：“足下何人，为何至此？
叶小天忙道：：“小娘子请了，在下叶小天，从京城里来，带了令尊杨霖杨老爷的亲笔书信来。”
那女子听了“啊”地一声惊呼，以手掩口，颤声问道：“你……你说什么，你带了谁的书信来？”
叶小天道：“小娘子是否先开了院门，容我进去说话。”
那女子这才反应过来，急急上前开门，待她取下门闩，拉开院门儿，叶小天刚要举步进去，就听胡同口传来一声大喊：“呔，兀那小子，干什么的？”
叶小天扭头一看，就见四五个汉子刚刚拐进胡同，头前一人青竹竿儿似的干瘪身材，正是方才喝令家奴打人的那位杨府大管事杨三瘦。
叶小天登时吃了一惊，有杨三瘦在，这几个人怕都不是善类，却不知他们来干什么，自己带来的那封杨霖遗书若是落到他们手中，那五百两银子必定鸡飞蛋打。
叶小天急忙闪进院子，对那少女道：“不好了，杨府里来了人，我这封书信至关重要，万万不能落到他们手里，杨姑娘，我先躲避一下，回头再来寻你计议大事。”
叶小天说罢，急急四下一看，就见墙角有个鸡窝，看那蛛网也不知有多久没养过鸡了，叶小天立即飞奔过去，一个箭步蹿上鸡窝，足尖一点，双臂一振，攀向墙头，就听“轰隆”一声，鸡窝塌了……
少女被这连番变故弄得茫然不知所措，看着在碎砖瓦砾中挣扎的叶小天正发愣的功夫，杨三瘦已领着几条壮汉冲进门来，气势汹汹地喝道：“你那奸夫逃到哪……，抓起来！”
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
叶小天被人推推搡搡的，终于从角门儿走进了他盼了两个月、走了两个月，最终却不敢踏出最后一步的杨家大院。杨三瘦押着叶小天兴高采烈，这个外乡小子鬼鬼祟祟的，定是与那贱婢有私情，就是没有，也可以硬说他有，夫人面前，还能短了自己的好处？嘿嘿！
杨三瘦越想越是高兴，又狠狠推了叶小天一把，喝道：“快点走，吃了熊心豹子胆了，竟然敢偷我杨家的女人，看三爷我一会儿怎么消遣你！”
叶小天心中好不纠结，这偷人的罪名可是不轻，但是要摆脱罪名，最直接最有效的办法就得取出书信说出真相，可他能说么，一旦说出来，那五百两银子就飞了，如果杨家人再黑一点，依旧咬定他是奸夫，那便连他这个人都要没了，叶小天对民间如何处治通奸者，却也是略有耳闻的。
那清柔女子也与他一同被绑了来，到了后宅一处月亮门下，自有内宅仆妇押那女子入内去见夫人，叶小天却被拦在了外面。
叶小天瞧见旁边还站着两三个人，似乎也在等候面见杨家主人，为首有一人五短身材，短须如刺，腰阔膀大，满脸横肉，他正搓着手，一见杨三瘦，便迎上来，急急问道：“三瘦兄，我那小娘子怎么绑进去了？”

杨三瘦冷哼道：“那个小贱人，竟敢败坏我杨家门风，与这小白脸私通，当真岂有此理。你且等着，待我家夫人用过家法之后，再把那小贱人与你带走。”

content_en:
Under this woman's fair and smooth forehead, a pair of dark eyebrows like distant mountains were frowning gently, as if there was an invisible trace of sadness locked away. The thin waist is tied with a thin belt, and a kind of elegance comes out of the bones.
She stood holding the door, and the door with mottled paint and cracks revealed a kind of elegance. Although she was dressed in commoner clothes and had a slim figure, she was unparalleled in beauty.
This girl is born with a softness that makes people pity her. The so-called misfortune does not necessarily mean that you are so beautiful that you can turn all sentient beings upside down, but that the kind of beauty and temperament can directly capture your heart, making silly men willing to work hard for her. The woman in front of you obviously has such conditions.
When Ye Xiaotian saw such a wonderful person, even though he was born under the emperor and had seen many beauties, he couldn't help but be stunned. He thought to himself: "Bad bamboos produce good bamboo shoots. Yang Lin's virtue is like that of a cricket. I didn't expect to give birth to a daughter with the appearance of a fox."
The girl lived alone in a shabby place and never interacted with anyone. Only a servant of the Yang family came to deliver brown rice once a month. This residence was in a dead end, and no one even passed by the door. Now she suddenly saw a strange man coming towards her. She was surprised and felt a little wary, and asked softly: "Who are you, and why are you here?
Ye Xiaotian said hurriedly: "My dear lady, please come. Ye Xiaotian came from the capital and brought a letter written by your father, Mr. Yang Lin and Mr. Yang. "
The woman exclaimed "Ah", covered her mouth with her hands, and asked in a trembling voice: "You... what did you say, whose letter did you bring? "
Ye Xiaotian said: "Can you please open the courtyard door first and let me go in to talk? "
Only then did the woman react and hurried forward to open the door. After she took off the latch and opened the courtyard door, Ye Xiaotian was about to step in when he heard a shout from the alley: "Hey, what are you doing, that boy?" "
Ye Xiaotian turned around and saw four or five men who had just turned into the alley. In front of them was a person with a withered figure like a green bamboo pole. It was Yang Sanshou, the chief steward of Yang Mansion, who had just ordered the servants to beat them.
Ye Xiaotian was immediately surprised. With Yang Sanshou here, these people were probably not good people, but he didn't know what they were doing. If the Yang Lin suicide note he brought fell into their hands, the five hundred taels of silver would definitely be lost.
Ye Xiaotian hurriedly walked into the yard and said to the girl: "Oh no, someone from Yang's house is here. This letter of mine is very important and must not fall into their hands. Miss Yang, I will hide for now and come back to you to discuss important matters." "
After Ye Xiaotian said that, he looked around hurriedly and saw a chicken coop in the corner. Looking at the spider web, he didn't know how long it had been since he had raised chickens. Ye Xiaotian immediately ran over, jumped up to the chicken coop, pointed his toes, raised his arms, and climbed to the top of the wall. Hearing a "bang", the chicken coop collapsed...
The girl was bewildered by this series of events. While she was looking at Ye Xiaotian struggling in the rubble, Yang Sanshou rushed in with several strong men and yelled menacingly: "Where did your adulterer escape to..., arrest him! "
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
Ye Xiaotian was pushed and pushed by others, and finally walked through the corner door into the Yang family compound that he had been looking forward to for two months and walked for two months, but finally did not dare to take the last step. Yang Sanshou was happily escorting Ye Xiaotian. This foreign boy was so sneaky that he must have had an affair with that cheap maid. Even if he didn't, you could just pretend that he did. How could he deprive himself of his own benefits in front of his wife? Hehe!
The more Yang Sanshou thought about it, the happier he became. He gave Ye Xiaotian a hard push and shouted: "Hurry up, you have become so bold that you dare to steal a woman from my Yang family. Let's see how I am going to entertain you later!" "
Ye Xiaotian was so entangled in his heart that the crime of stealing was not a light one, but to get rid of the crime, the most direct and effective way was to take out the letter and tell the truth, but heCan you tell me, once you say it, the five hundred taels of silver will fly away. If the Yang family is more sinister and still insists that he is an adulterer, then even he will be lost. Ye Xiaotian also knows a little about how the people deal with adulterers.
The innocent woman was also kidnapped together with him. When they arrived at the moon gate in the back house, a servant girl escorted the woman inside to see his wife, but Ye Xiaotian was blocked outside.
Ye Xiaotian saw two or three people standing next to him, who seemed to be waiting to meet the master of the Yang family. The leader was a man of short stature, with a short beard like a thorn, a broad waist and broad shoulders, and a face full of flesh. He was rubbing his hands. When he saw Yang Sanshou, he came up to him and asked hurriedly: "Brother Sanshou, why is my little lady tied up?"
Yang Sanshou snorted coldly: "That little bitch dared to ruin the family tradition of my Yang family and have an affair with this pretty boy. It's really unreasonable. Just wait until my wife uses her family's methods before taking that little bitch away with you."
